scientific_integrity: All \(2^{16}\) linear endomorphisms are exhausted. Accepted maps are rechecked on all \(256\) ordered element pairs, minimal polynomials are computed exactly over \(\mathbb F_2\), and the algebra automorphism group and orbit partitions are exhausted. Literature noncoverage is stated as a residual risk rather than absolute novelty proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the associative algebra \(M_2(\mathbb F_2)\). It does not establish the extremal classification for larger matrix size or for arbitrary larger characteristic-two fields.
title: Extremal Rota–Baxter rigidity on \(M_2(\mathbb F_2)\)
